name: Result
summary: A full-block outcome state — success, error, info, warning, 404, 403 or 500 — with an icon, title and actions.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-result> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `status` picks the DS glyph and colour (success · error · info · warning · 404 · 403 · 500), `result-title` / `subtitle` carry the message, an `icon` attribute overrides the glyph with any DS icon name, and a `slot="extra"` holds follow-up buttons. The status glyph is the shared <aha-icon> BY NAME — never an inline <svg>. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

opinion.note: Reserve Result for a whole-region outcome — lead with the glyph + a clear title, keep the subtitle to one line, and give a primary next action in slot="extra". For an in-context message use an Alert; for a transient confirmation use a Toast.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 has no measured Result component-set (a Figma search for Result/Empty state/Status page on MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy returns only unrelated legacy/mockup nodes). The matrix is therefore derived from antd Result conventions + the token layer (status colours color-success/error/warning/info, error reused for 500, warning for 403) + the DS icon library (check-circle, x-circle, warning-circle, info, magnifying-glass-exclamation, lock, cloud-disconnected). Full status axis success/error/info/warning/404/403/500 plus a custom `icon` override. A deliberate, documented extension.
